data.name: Mutmainah
data.gender_notes: Mutmainah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mutmainah is a female name that means 'one who is contented, satisfied, or tranquil'. It comes from the Arabic word 'mutmain' which means 'safe, secure, or assured'. The name Mutmainah carries the meaning “Contented, Satisfied” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mutmainah usually hope their child will grow to embody contented, satisfied and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The spiritual meaning of Mutmainah is to find peace and tranquility in your faith and relationship with Allah.
data.etymology: Mutmainah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contented, Satisfied.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mutmainah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
